intro: New sounds for the Gulp (2026-10-16): the suck, the catch and the throw, which play all the time, so they should be short and pleasant to hear hundreds of times. Your own sounds are here as "Yours" options (trimmed and levelled only); the generated ones are short Magnific takes; "Now" is what the game played before this round. Press Repeat to hear an option eight times in a row at the game's small pitch spread. The game plays your suck2, the bubble pop and your throwing3 meanwhile (?audition and F7/F8 switch options in the game). Pick one per sound, or choose Neither and say how it should sound.

groups.name: Suck
groups.note: Q with an empty mouth: the slime breathes in and whatever is in reach flies into its mouth (about 0.2 s later). It plays at the start of every suck.

groups.name: Catch
groups.note: The thing lands in the mouth and the hold begins; also the bag's Use putting an essence in the mouth, and the ceremony's bubble going down.

groups.name: Throw
groups.note: Q while holding: the thing is thrown along the aim (it flies about half a second and breaks with its own material sound). An essence is spat out whole with the same sound.
